summary: Polestar Automotive Holding UK PLC filed a Form 6-K reporting results of its 2026 annual general meeting. All 16 resolutions—covering annual report approval, director re-appointments, auditor appointment (PwC replacing Deloitte), and authority to issue shares—were approved by shareholders. The filing is a routine AGM outcome report with no special-situation event such as a takeover, spin-off, or restructuring.
